rd.where: section 4.11.1, table 4-28, page 245: Rd is 5.1 kohm to GND; +-10 % can detect the power capability, +-20 % cannot; note 2: the total resistance into the CC pin

cc_max.where: section 4.11.1, table 4-28, page 245: the max voltage on the pin, 2.04 V for Rd +-10 % and 2.18 V for Rd +-20 %

advertisements.name: default
advertisements.where: section 4.6.2.1, page 226: Default is 500 mA for USB 2.0 ports, and a Power Sinking Device may draw up to 500 mA; table 4-20, page 227
advertisements.rp_where: section 4.11.1, table 4-27, page 245: Default USB Power, a resistor of 56 kohm +-20 % pulled up to 4.75 to 5.5 V

advertisements.name: 1.5A
advertisements.where: section 4.6.2.1, table 4-20, page 227: USB Type-C Current 1.5 A
advertisements.rp_where: section 4.11.1, table 4-27, page 245: 1.5 A @ 5 V, a resistor of 22 kohm +-5 % pulled up to 4.75 to 5.5 V

advertisements.name: 3.0A
advertisements.where: section 4.6.2.1, table 4-20, page 227: USB Type-C Current 3.0 A
advertisements.rp_where: section 4.11.1, table 4-27, page 245: 3.0 A @ 5 V, a resistor of 10 kohm +-5 % pulled up to 4.75 to 5.5 V

connected.where: section 4.11.3.2.1, table 4-35, page 254: vRd-connected, for Rd +-20 %

beyond.where: section 4.6, table 4-19, page 225: over 3.0 A at 5 V is USB PD only, which this block does not build

pullup_volts.where: section 4.11.1, table 4-27, page 245: a resistor pull-up to 4.75 to 5.5 V

vbus_volts.where: USB 2.0 ECN VBUS Max Limit, change (c) to section 7.3.2, table 7-7, page 4: a high-power port supplies 4.75 V to 5.50 V

vbus_farads.where: section 7.3.2, table 7-7, CRPB, page 179, and section 7.2.4.1, page 177: 1.0 uF to 10.0 uF on VBUS; Device Capacitance ECN, page 2: more than 1.0 uF from 0 V to 5.25 V

vbus_bias.where: Device Capacitance ECN, page 2: CRPB across the whole VBUS voltage range, 0 V to 5.25 V

data_volts.where: section 7.3.2, table 7-7, pages 178 and 179: VOH at most 3.6 V and VIHZ at most 3.6 V on D+ and D-

wiring.shell: section 3.2.1, the notes of figure 3-1, note 11, page 47: the receptacle shell shall be connected to the PCB ground plane
wiring.vbus: section 3.2.3, table 3-5, note 4, page 77: all VBUS pins connected together at the receptacle
wiring.gnd: section 3.2.3, table 3-5, note 5, page 77: all ground return pins connected together at the receptacle
wiring.data: section 3.2.3, table 3-5, note 2, page 77: Dp1 and Dp2 shorted, and Dn1 and Dn2, as close to the receptacle as possible
wiring.sbu: section 3.2.3, table 3-5, note 3, page 77: SBU1 and SBU2 shall not be connected unless required for a specified purpose

amps_vbus.where: Electrical, Current Rating, page 1: 5.00 A collectively for VBUS pins

placement.where: section 5, Pin Functions, page 3: connect IO1 and IO2 to the data line as close to the connector as possible
